status: Original portrait drafts; visual refinement and full actor artwork remain open
authorship: Drawn pixel by pixel as explicit indexed rows on blank 18x16 grids. No donor character pixels are copied. Native FFTA palettes and proportions are references. These rows were authored in source, not painted through the desktop editor.
encoding: One hexadecimal palette index per pixel; dots are transparent. Rows are right-padded to 18 pixels.
